from collections import deque
def comps_of(g,bg,cell):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==cell and not seen[i][j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]);seen[i][j]=1;cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft();cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==cell:
